Grandstream GRP2602P Basic HD IP Phone With Adapter


Upgrade your office or call center communication with the Grandstream GRP2602P Basic HD IP Phone With Adapter. Designed for businesses in Bangladesh, this SIP-based VoIP phone offers reliable, high-quality audio, easy management, and efficient multi-line handling for professional environments.


Key Features:


  • 2 Lines / 4 SIP Accounts: Handle multiple extensions and SIP accounts simultaneously, perfect for small to mid-sized offices and call centers.
  • HD Audio: Crystal-clear sound quality with noise reduction technology for handset, speakerphone, and headset calls.
  • 5-Way Voice Conferencing: Conduct team meetings or multi-party calls directly from the phone without additional equipment.
  • Graphical LCD Display: Easy-to-read screen for intuitive navigation and call management.
  • PoE (Power over Ethernet) Support: Power the device and connect to the network using a single Ethernet cable. Comes with adapter for non-PoE setups.
  • EHS Headset Support: Compatible with Plantronics, Jabra, and Sennheiser EHS-enabled headsets for hands-free operation.
  • Enterprise-Grade Security: Features secure boot, encrypted storage, and dual firmware images to protect your communications.
  • Centralized Management: Supports zero-touch provisioning and management via Grandstream Device Management System (GDMS) for easy deployment across multiple devices.
  • Wall-Mountable Design: Flexible installation options for desks or wall setups.
